title: No One Can Read This 600-Year-Old Book
sources: Yale Beinecke Rare Book & Manuscript Library, MS 408 (the Voynich Manuscript): written in an unknown script, illustrated with unidentified plants, astronomical diagrams and bathing figures; named after book dealer Wilfrid Voynich, who acquired it in 1912
Live Science / NBC News (Feb 2011), 'Mystery Book Gives Up a Secret': University of Arizona radiocarbon dating put the vellum at 1404-1438
Wikipedia, 'Voynich manuscript': about 240 pages; WWII-era codebreakers including William Friedman failed to decipher it; many claimed solutions, none accepted

lines.text: Nobody on Earth can read this book, and it's six hundred years old.
